body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand. The underhook player has an underhook. The overhook player has an overhook.

Underhook player: move your partner and get to the head, waist, or a leg. The waist wins right away. A head or leg connection must be turned into a waist connection to win. Overhook player: use the overhook to keep him away, freeing the head or leg before he reaches the waist.

items: The underhook player wins by getting to the waist, directly or from the head or a leg.
The overhook player wins by freeing a head or leg connection.

body.text: SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is belly up in open guard. The top player is on his feet, starting by clearing the feet.

Top player: get one leg outside the bottom player's feet, make shin contact from knee to head, then without stopping go around to the other side and touch there too. Bottom player: hook and post with your feet to make the top player hit his butt, then sit up with your back off the mat.

items: The top player wins by touching one outside and then the other, one right after the other.
The bottom player wins by making the top player hit his butt and sitting up with his back off the mat.

body.text: SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is on his back. The top player covers his head with a figure-four grip, one hand on the wrist, the other arm under the elbow.

Top player: keep the figure-four grip and stay under at least one elbow while keeping the bottom player pinned. Bottom player: break the grip by freeing your arms and getting your elbows to your body.

items: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps the grip.
The bottom player wins by breaking the grip.
